Quaternius — Universal Base Characters
=======================================

Source pack: Universal Base Characters Kit by Quaternius
Product page: https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters
Author site: https://quaternius.com/

License (from the author's product page, quoted 2026-10-17):
  "Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects. (CC0 License)"

File in this repo: base_character.glb — the single-file rigged character with
the Universal Animation Library clips embedded, as distributed for the kit
(fetched via the author's poly.pizza hosting; the mirror labels the upload
CC-BY 3.0, the upstream kit license above is CC0 — credited anyway).
